subject: POC evaluation approach / success criteria & timeline
messages:
From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>
To: Alicia Wu <alicia.wu@clinixhealth.com>, Ellis Barnes <ellis@clinixhealth.com>
Cc: aditya_rao@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 21 May 2027 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: POC evaluation approach / success criteria & timeline

Hi Alicia / Ellis —

Great to meet earlier. Quick recap + proposed next steps so we have alignment on how Clinix should validate Redwood for triage-assist (low-latency suggestions during intake). High-level ask from your side: measure accuracy vs current heuristics and confirm latency/cost at expected volume.

Proposed success criteria (attached spreadsheet has editable numbers):
- Functional: precision@1 >= 0.78 on intake intent classification (sample test set of 3k anonymized items)
- UX/latency: 95th percentile inference latency < 350ms for 1-2 token responses under expected burst profile
- Reliability: end-to-end availability >= 99.5% across 2 weeks of shadowing
- Ops: clear cost target (tokens/month) and rollback plan if quality drops > 5%

Evaluation route options (you asked about offline vs shadow):
1) Offline-first (recommended minimum): we run an offline eval against your de-identified sample + holdout (we provide eval harness). Fast, low-risk.
2) Short shadow run (recommended to validate ops): 1 business-week of live shadow traffic routed to Redwood (no user-facing changes) to validate latency, cache effects, and false positives in production patterns.
3) Hybrid (best): offline baseline + 5-day shadow focused on peak hours.

Proposed timeline:
- Week 0 (this week): exchange NDA/DSA snippets if needed + dataset sample (anonymized)
- Week 1: Redwood runs offline eval; we share detailed scorecard
- Week 2: Execute 5-day shadow (if agreed), collect telemetry and final scorecard
- Week 3: Decision meeting and next steps (dedicated or hosted pilot)

Owners:
- Redwood: Irene (program lead) + Aditya (eval harness and metrics)
- Clinix: Alicia (product), Ellis (ops)

Attachments: clinix-poc-success-criteria.xlsx (spreadsheet with editable thresholds), redwood-eval-methods-onepager.pdf

Questions for you to confirm:
- Which eval route would you prefer (offline / shadow / hybrid)?
- Can you share a 3k-sample of de-identified intake records by EOD Monday?
- Any procurement/security gating (DocuSign, SOC2) we should prep for now?

Thanks — aiming to keep initial friction low so you can validate quickly.

Best,
Irene Choi
Senior Solutions Manager
Redwood Inference
irene.choi@redwood.ai

From: Alicia Wu <alicia.wu@clinixhealth.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ellis Barnes <ellis@clinixhealth.com>
Date: Mon, 24 May 2027 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: POC evaluation approach / success criteria & timeline

Hi Irene —

Thanks for the clear recap. We’re aligned on objectives. A few quick answers and asks:

- Route: leaning hybrid. We want offline first to confirm signal, but we also need a short shadow to validate latency under real traffic.
- Dataset: I’ll work with our data team to export a 3k de-identified sample. Can deliver by Wednesday EOD (May 26). We’ll strip PHI and replace identifiers with consistent tokens.
- Security/procurement: we need SOC2 Type II and standard DPA. Also please share any required vendor onboarding docs (W-9 / supplier form).
- Success thresholds: the precision@1 target looks reasonable; can you add an explicit false-positive / recall threshold in the spreadsheet? We care about avoiding over-triage.

Next meeting: can we set a 30-minute kickoff Wednesday afternoon to confirm dataset schema and shadow window (if agreed)?

Thanks,
Alicia
Director, Product
Clinix Health
alicia.wu@clinixhealth.com

From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 25 May 2027 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: POC evaluation approach / success criteria & timeline

Irene / Marissa —

Quick internal note on the evaluation plan (my recommendation for a low-friction, high-confidence signal):

Recommendation: Hybrid with staged acceptance gates. Steps and deliverables:
- Offline stage (Aditya): run evaluation harness on Clinix 3k sample. Produce per-intent confusion matrix, precision@k (k=1,3), recall, and a small error catalog with 50 representative misclassifications.
- Shadow stage (Irene): 5 full business days, but only route 10% of live traffic to Redwood in a read-only path (no user-facing changes). Collect latency percentiles, token counts, cache-hit rate, and real-time false-positive rate.
- Acceptance rubric (scorecard weights):
  - Offline quality (precision@1): 40%
  - Shadow latency & SLOs: 30%
  - False-positive operational impact (FP rate > threshold): 20%
  - Operational readiness (logs, tracing, rollbacks): 10%

Pass/fail: require weighted score >= 75% to proceed to pilot. If offline is strongly negative (precision@1 < 0.65) stop and recommend further model work before shadowing.

Data handling: request that Clinix share schema + anonymized records via our secure S3 ingestion link (we’ll provide presigned URL). We can also run the offline harness inside a Clinix VPC if they prefer.

I’ll prepare the eval harness runbook and example metrics dashboard today and attach to the kickoff.

-Aditya
Principal ML Engineer
Redwood Inference
aditya.rao@redwood.ai

Alicia / Ellis —

Thanks — hybrid it is. Confirming next steps and owners so we can move quickly:

1) Dataset handoff (owner: Alicia) — Clinix to deliver 3k de-identified sample by Wed May 26 EOD. We’ll provide presigned S3 link and upload instructions.
2) Offline eval (owner: Aditya) — Aditya will run harness on sample and share scorecard by Fri May 28 COB. Deliverables: scorecard, confusion matrix, 50-case error catalog.
3) Shadow run coordination (owner: Irene) — if offline passes (> 0.65 precision@1), we’ll schedule 5-day 10%-traffic shadow starting Mon Jun 7. We’ll confirm exact windows during our kickoff.
4) Security/procurement (owner: Irene) — I’ll attach our SOC2 summary and vendor onboarding packet to the kickoff calendar invite; please send any supplier forms you require.

Kickoff: I’ve scheduled a 30-min kickoff for Wed May 26 3:00pm PT — invite sent. Agenda: dataset schema, S3 details, shadow window options, success thresholds + sign-off flow.

Attachments included again: clinix-poc-success-criteria.xlsx, redwood-eval-methods-onepager.pdf

If anything needs to shift (dates or owners), reply-all and we’ll update. Looking forward — this should be lightweight and give Clinix confidence quickly.

Best,
